How do I use Goal Seek?:
Based on the document, follow these steps to use Goal Seek:

* **Step 1:** Select the Profit cell, go to the **Data** tab, click on **What-if Analysis**, and select **Goal seek** (p. 28).
* **Step 2:** In the Goal Seek dialog box (p. 29):
  * **Set cell:** Select the result cell (i.e. Profit).  
  * **To value:** Enter the target value (i.e. desired profit [2000]).  
  * **By changing cell:** Select the input cell (i.e. Qty).  
* **Step 3:** Click **OK**. Excel automatically calculates and displays the required input value. Click **OK** to apply the result (p. 29).
